titles.english: Rokka: Braves of the Six Flowers Picture Drama
titles.native: 六花の勇者　ピクチャードラマ

description: Picture dramas bundled with the Blu-ray and DVD volumes. The first tale features Nashetania 6 years ago when she was just 12 years old amidst the turmoil in her nation, the next features Fremy's encounter with a young girl, and the third features Adlet.
